description: This file defines a 'Product' model class used in the application. It includes properties for product details such as id, name, description, price, image URL, category, stock quantity, availability status, and timestamps for creation and updates. It also provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and copying with modifications.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Model class representing a product in the application.

methods.name: Product.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a Product instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts a Product instance into a JSON map.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Product with optional modified fields.
